Hello!
I'm Octavian Halmaghi a a software developer and formerly a mathematics graduate student. My mathematical interests differential geometry,and symplectic geometry, and algebra. I am also interested in the formalization of mathematics and have been learning Lean. I have introduced a Mathlib PR for virtually cyclic groups is submitted and open: github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/43239, awaiting CI and review.

Hi! I have left some comment in the PR. I am not an official reviewer so here is just my personal suggestion. If you are interested in contributing to Mathlib, may I suggest also taking a look at other PRs, learning guidelines from their code and review comments, and also helping with review?
